data.body: AC amendment (gap G3): --mode default. inject-and-heal.sh invokes 'python3 -m dso_reconciler --repo-root ${REPO_ROOT}' with NO --mode flag. If argparse declares --mode required=True, every drift-injection run breaks. Resolution: --mode has a default of Mode.LIVE.value when omitted (the steady-state production mode). Add a RED test asserting the no-flag invocation path defaults to Mode.LIVE. AC grep on inject-and-heal.sh stays valid: 'python3 -m dso_reconciler' substring confirms the existing invocation surface is preserved.
